job_description_raw: 职责概述 医学信息沟通专员在医学信息沟通地区经理的领导和辅导下，负责所辖区域内的产品学术推广和客户专业支持，如拜访客户传递/沟通/反馈药品信息、召开产品学术推广活动等，从而实现工作目标（包括但不限于专业技能、行为、合规及业绩等综合考评目标）。 主要工作和任务 1. 在公司政策和程序指引下向客户提供及时准确的专业支持，建立合作伙伴关系。 2. 在公司政策和程序指引下充分利用资源进行有效的客户拜访，实现工作目标。 3. 在公司政策和程序指引下规划和组织各种学术会议或活动。 4. 通过公司管理系统以及其他合规的渠道和方式，收集市场和客户反馈的信息，进行分析，反馈和建议。 5. 与上级经理，同事和其他部门的业务伙伴保持有效的联络，发现和促进各种合作机会。 6. 在上级经理的辅导下，把握各种学习机会不断提升专业知识和能力。 7. 执行公司推行的各项新举措，在公司政策和程序引导下探索创新和优化的机会 8. 完成上级经理指派的其他各项工作。 任职要求 · 教育： - 大学本科及以上学历，医学，药学，生命科学等相关专业优先。 · 技能： - 熟练使用MS Office，英语良好。 - 具有较强的沟通能力和团队合作意识。 - 具备较强的学习意愿和学习能力。 - 善于自我激励，自我挑战和管理压力。 · 经验 ： - 医药行业相关工作经验优先。 · 诚信： - 能够严格管理自己的行为，确保日常工作全部遵循公司政策、行业准则以及相关法律，包括但不限于 FCPA (《反海外腐败法》)及相关中国大陆境内相关反腐法律条款。严守诚信，保持真实透明，在过往的工作中无任何违反法律规定的行为发生。 · 内部申请资格： 内部申请人需符合合规调查流程，处分等级&时限等要求。 核心能力 专业合规: 坚持专业推广-掌握并正确运用产品，治疗，疾病领域的知识，面对客户展现专业形象。严格坚守合规-工作中严格遵从合规要求，及时澄清问题并报告有合规风险的行为。 业务决断: 把握市场动态-随时把握市场动态，并且能敏锐地发现学术推广机会。 有效利用信息-合法合规地收集和运用信息，有理有据地分析并从中挖掘学术推广机会。 客户融动: 提供专业支持-积极与外部客户，包括医生，专家和其他合作伙伴进行互动，快速响应客户的学术需求，准确及时地提供专业支持。 主动促进合作-对内部客户主动沟通，寻求机会促进相互理解，建立合作关系。 自主执行: 高效准确执行-及时准确不打折扣地执行各项工作。 主动承担任务-对待工作认真负责，有始有终，遇到问题主动承担，遇到困难坚持达成目标。 自我发展: 主动提升能力-把握内外部各种学习机会和资源，不断提升自身的能力和适应力。 创新变革: 积极拥抱变化-用开放的心态面对创新和变化，积极尝试新方法。 Pfizer is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable equal employment opportunity legislation in each jurisdiction in which it operates. To learn more about acceptable and prohibited uses of AI during the recruitment process, please review our candidate AI-use guidelines available on Pfizer Careers . Sales

job_description_raw: 职责概述 医学信息沟通专员在医学信息沟通地区经理的领导和辅导下，负责所辖区域内的产品学术推广和客户专业支持，如拜访客户传递/沟通/反馈药品信息、召开产品学术推广活动等，从而实现工作目标（包括但不限于专业技能、行为、合规及业绩等综合考评目标）。 主要工作和任务 1. 在公司政策和程序指引下向客户提供及时准确的专业支持，建立合作伙伴关系。 2. 在公司政策和程序指引下充分利用资源进行有效的客户拜访，实现工作目标。 3. 在公司政策和程序指引下规划和组织各种学术会议或活动。 4. 通过公司管理系统以及其他合规的渠道和方式，收集市场和客户反馈的信息，进行分析，反馈和建议。 5. 与上级经理，同事和其他部门的业务伙伴保持有效的联络，发现和促进各种合作机会。 6. 在上级经理的辅导下，把握各种学习机会不断提升专业知识和能力。 7. 执行公司推行的各项新举措，在公司政策和程序引导下探索创新和优化的机会 8. 完成上级经理指派的其他各项工作。 任职要求 · 教育： - 大学本科及以上学历，医学，药学，生命科学等相关专业优先。 · 技能： - 熟练使用MS Office，英语良好。 - 具有较强的沟通能力和团队合作意识。 - 具备较强的学习意愿和学习能力。 - 善于自我激励，自我挑战和管理压力。 · 经验 ： - 医药行业相关工作经验优先。 · 诚信： - 能够严格管理自己的行为，确保日常工作全部遵循公司政策、行业准则以及相关法律，包括但不限于 FCPA (《反海外腐败法》)及相关中国大陆境内相关反腐法律条款。严守诚信，保持真实透明，在过往的工作中无任何违反法律规定的行为发生。 · 内部申请资格： 内部申请人需符合合规调查流程，处分等级&时限等要求。 核心能力 专业合规: 坚持专业推广-掌握并正确运用产品，治疗，疾病领域的知识，面对客户展现专业形象。严格坚守合规-工作中严格遵从合规要求，及时澄清问题并报告有合规风险的行为。 业务决断: 把握市场动态-随时把握市场动态，并且能敏锐地发现学术推广机会。 有效利用信息-合法合规地收集和运用信息，有理有据地分析并从中挖掘学术推广机会。 客户融动: 提供专业支持-积极与外部客户，包括医生，专家和其他合作伙伴进行互动，快速响应客户的学术需求，准确及时地提供专业支持。 主动促进合作-对内部客户主动沟通，寻求机会促进相互理解，建立合作关系。 自主执行: 高效准确执行-及时准确不打折扣地执行各项工作。 主动承担任务-对待工作认真负责，有始有终，遇到问题主动承担，遇到困难坚持达成目标。 自我发展: 主动提升能力-把握内外部各种学习机会和资源，不断提升自身的能力和适应力。 创新变革: 积极拥抱变化-用开放的心态面对创新和变化，积极尝试新方法。 Pfizer is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable equal employment opportunity legislation in each jurisdiction in which it operates. To learn more about acceptable and prohibited uses of AI during the recruitment process, please review our candidate AI-use guidelines available on Pfizer Careers . Sales

 You’ll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible—while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more. 
 At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We’re committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits . 
 Role Description: 
 The Technical Configuration Management (TCM) function ensures the accuracy, consistency, and traceability of product configurations across the business unit. TCM professionals serve as key liaisons between Sales / Account Teams and internal stakeholders within the Business Unit, aids Sales in customer-facing configuration-focused interactions, manage configuration documentation, coordinate cross-functional configuration reviews, and maintain configuration integrity throughout the customer order lifecycle. TCM plays a critical role in enabling efficient product delivery, optimizing customer order hardware and software content, and supporting business growth through configuration excellence.
 This is a business-critical role requiring high attention to detail. Candidates must be prepared for significant operational demands and time-sensitive deliverables. Candidates must possess the ability to work effectively under pressure and manage shifting priorities.
 Key Responsibilities: 
 Manage and maintain product configurations in alignment with customer specifications and internal standards.
 Function as the primary interface for Sales / Account Teams for configuration requests and issue resolution.
 Collaborate with Sales, Business Management, Product Line Management, and Engineering to validate and maintain accurate customer order configurations.
 Maintain comprehensive and auditable records of configuration changes and customer interactions.
 Support configuration-related project activities, including planning, tracking, and providing input to execution of configuration freeze and validation.
 Participate in New Product Integration (NPI) and Continuous Improvement Processes (CIP) to ensure configuration readiness and consistency over time.
 Required Skills: 
 Proficiency in configuration management tools and processes, including Product Architecture, BOM management, Engineering changes, and Configuration Accuracy discussions.
 Ability to work across multiple functions including Product Line Management, Engineering, Manufacturing, Business Management, and Sales to align configuration requirements and resolve configuration-related issues.
 Ability to work effectively under pressure and manage shifting priorities.
 Cross-regional collaboration and experience in matrix organizations are essential.
 Experience in customer-facing roles or account support, with the ability to translate customer requirements into actionable configuration plans.
 Demonstrated capability in technical project management, including planning, tracking, and executing configuration milestones.
 Ability to manage complex configuration histories and ensure traceability across multiple product revisions and customer engagements.
 Strong analytical and critical thinking skills
 Preferred skills 
 Familiarity with business unit operations and product line strategy, enabling alignment of configuration activities with broader business goals.
 Understanding of product lifecycle processes and sustaining engineering practices
 Qualifications 
 Solid foundation in Engineering (mechanical, electrical, systems, process) with direct experience in semiconductor equipment design, manufacturing, field installation, or maintenance and support
 More than seven years of semiconductor manufacturing or semiconductor equipment industry experience with a blend of technical depth and operational execution.
 The role requires always understanding and following Applied Materials’ Global Standards of Business Conduct. This includes demonstrating the highest level of ethical conduct reflecting Applied Materials' core values.

Full time

Assignee / Regular

Yes, 20% of the Time

Yes

As a Field Service Engineer [Customer Engineer] at Applied Materials, you serve as the direct liaison with customers, collaborating closely to install, maintain, and upgrade equipment. You'll use digital analytics for troubleshooting and apply basic diagnostic techniques to assess and address technical issues. Your responsibilities include performing preventative and corrective maintenance on various systems such as electrical, vacuum, mechanical, plasma, hydraulic, and gas systems. Additionally, you'll coordinate and communicate directly with customers to ensure smooth operations and exceptional service.  
 Role Responsibilities:   
 Install, maintain, and upgrade customer equipment
 Apply basic diagnostic techniques to assess equipment and address technical issues, with assistance from Senior Field Service Engineers [Customer Engineers]
 Collaborate with Senior Field Service Engineers [Customer Engineers] and/or the customer to understand roadmaps, process flows, inflection points, requirements, and business challenges   
 Train and mentor junior Field Service Engineers [Customer Engineers]
 Perform preventative and corrective maintenance on electrical, vacuum, mechanical, plasma, hydraulic, and gas systems
 Coordinate and communicate directly with customers
 Fulfill additional duties, as assigned
 Minimum Qualifications:   
 Completion of an Associate degree, military technical training, field service experience, or trade certification
 4-7 years of work experience in semiconductor industry or other equipment support industry
 Advanced mechanical aptitude with pneumatics, hydraulics, electronics, vacuum, and/or thermodynamics
 Strong knowledge of hand tools and their appropriate usage, including digital multimeters
 Effective written and verbal communication skills
 Basic knowledge of Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint   
 Possession of a valid driver’s license and the ability to obtain a passport, if travel is required.
 Able to meet all on-site requirements, including safety, environmental guidelines, and COVID-19 protocols
 Physical Requirements:   
This position often requires extensive walking, standing for extended periods of time, working in tight spaces, bending, squatting, twisting, kneeling, reaching, climbing stairs and ladders, working at height, lifting up to 35 lbs., the ability to distinguish between colors and working with electricity, the ability to work in an environment with noise that may be difficult for some individuals with sensitivity to noise, and the use of hand and power tools.   Additionally, because this position generally involves working in a clean room, it requires the use of appropriate Personal Protective Equipment such as coveralls, hoods, booties, safety glasses, gloves, respirators, chemical aprons, and face shields.

job_description_raw: 主要职责： 1.制订并执行KA客户在区域内的年度销售计划，完成KA客户的年度销售目标，完成或超越完成公司和上级经理下达的各项工作目标和任务； 2. 协助所负责的KA客户对年度投入进行费用测算，确保按照年度分解指标实现销售业绩；按合作计划约定跟进落实KA客户重点分部及门店市场活动及相关培训开展，实现定期拜访并及时反馈/建议； 3.按照月度管理KA客户销售产品的数据整理及测算，做好沟通反馈，确保数据详实准确； 4.跟踪KA客户进销存数据，及时进行分析，向管理层和销售团队提供有价值的数据信息； 5.审核所负责KA客户的陈列协议，费用控制在预算内； 6.协调公司总部在KA客户开展的合作项目，做好项目的推进及协调沟通工作，提升客户的数据安全性； 7. 监控和分析市场发展趋势，挖掘区域市场机会，为公司策略的制订提供反馈和建议； 8. 协调并有效地实施各个项目及活动，合理分配和控制各项资源。有效管理项目和活动的流程，确保其真实有效地开展； 9. 熟悉对当前及未来业务有影响的政策，必要情况下可根据公司的要求，与相关职能部门合作，参与或协调所辖区域的市场准入工作； 10. 建立和保持有效沟通系统，定期与上级经理汇报区域工作进展，与NKA团队及其他部门建立协作关系； 11. 为制订和修改销售相关的政策和流程及其他内部政策提供建议，以实现高效率的销售运作； 12. 支持公司的各项创新举措，主动探索创新的机会和方法； 13. 完成上级经理指派的其他各项工作。 岗位要求： 教育： 大学本科及以上学历，医学，药学，生命科学等相关专业优先。 工作经验： 外部应聘者需3年或以上制药行业同等公司的销售工作经验。 有2年以上销售管理经验或KA客户管理经验者优先。 技能： 良好的中英文表达、写作能力和办公软件操作技能。 具备较好的相关产品领域的专业知识。 具备较强的影响力和策略性思维能力。 具备较强的沟通，计划，组织和问题解决能力。 具有较强的团队合作意识。 具备较强的学习意愿和学习能力。 善于自我激励，自我挑战和管理压力。 诚信： 能够严格管理自己的行为，确保日常工作全部遵循公司政策、行业准则以及相关法律，包括但不限于FCPA (《反海外腐败法》)及相关中国大陆境内相关反腐法律条款。严守诚信，保持真实透明，在过往的工作中无任何违反法律规定的行为发生。 内部申请资格： 内部申请人需符合合规调查流程，处分等级&时限等要求。 Pfizer is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable equal employment opportunity legislation in each jurisdiction in which it operates. job_description_raw: 制定并执行负责区域KA客户年度销售计划，围绕公司年度经营目标进行目标分解与落地，推动完成KA客户年度销售指标及公司、上级经理下达的各项工作目标和任务。 负责KA客户年度投入及费用预算管理，根据年度销售目标合理规划客户投入，确保各项费用与业务目标相匹配；按照年度指标分解及合作计划，跟进并落实重点分部及门店的市场活动、推广项目和相关培训，持续跟踪执行效果并及时反馈及提出改进建议。 负责KA客户销售数据的整理、测算与沟通反馈，按照月度管理要求完成销售相关数据的收集、核对和分析，确保数据及时、准确、完整，为业务决策和销售管理提供数据支持。 持续跟踪KA客户进销存及终端销售数据，定期开展数据分析，及时识别销售趋势、库存变化及潜在业务机会，为管理层和销售团队提供有价值的数据洞察和决策支持。 负责KA客户陈列协议及相关费用管理，审核客户陈列协议及费用使用情况，确保相关业务活动符合公司要求，并将费用控制在批准预算范围内，提高费用投入的合理性和有效性。 协调公司总部与KA客户开展各类合作项目，负责项目落地过程中的推进、协调与沟通，及时解决执行过程中出现的问题，推动合作项目顺利实施，持续提升客户合作质量及业务产出。 Pfizer is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable equal employment opportunity legislation in each jurisdiction in which it operates. （Senior） Diagnostic Strategy & Solutions Manager Team: Diagnostics & Marketing Operations Optimization Reports to: Head of Diagnostics & Marketing Operations Optimization Location: Beijing / Shanghai I. Role Purpose 1. Develop diagnostic strategies and solutions for priority disease areas and product portfolios by identifying critical barriers across patient screening, test ordering, testing, and clinical application along the patient journey. 2. Enable the translation of diagnostic results into clinical decisions and improved patient outcomes through professional education, testing capability building, pathway optimization, and ecosystem partnerships. 3. Partner with internal and external stakeholders to design and implement measurable, replicable, and scalable diagnostic programs, while exploring the application of innovative technologies, including artificial intelligence. 4. Be accountable for strategy execution, delivery of priority projects, and measurable improvements in patient identification and clinical pathways. II. Key Responsibilities 1. Develop diagnostic strategies and implement solutions · Define diagnostic strategies and annual priorities for disease areas and product portfolios based on patient journeys, clinical needs, technology trends, and business objectives. · Translate diagnostic needs into executable programs, strengthen testing capabilities, optimize workflows, and develop replicable tools and implementation models. · Connect patient identification, risk stratification, testing, and treatment decision-making to translate diagnostic results into clinical action and enable integrated diagnosis and treatment pathways. 2. job_description_raw: 职责概述 医学信息沟通大区经理负责管理所辖区域的一切业务，包括制订和实施区域的工作目标和发展计划，建立一个绩效良好、极富生产力和士气高昂的团队。对客户的需求做出适当反应以实现区域的各项工作目标。对团队成员的行为进行规范和监管，对他们的专业技能提升和学习发展规划提供辅导和支持。 主要工作和任务 1. 制订并执行所辖区域的业务计划，推动大区各个团队实现公司和上级下达的各项工作目标和任务。 2. 招聘符合公司基本要求的人员，定期对团队成员进行绩效和行为的评估，实施奖惩或激励措施。 3. 制订并执行培养团队成员合规意识的计划，规范员工的工作行为，确保各项活动的真实性和合规性。 4. 制订并执行团队成员专业知识和技能的发展计划，通过随访对团队成员定期进行教导，以加强其专业能力、产品知识、产品策略、医学信息沟通技巧和总体工作效率，并对其个人发展规划提供指导与支持。 5. 根据大区业务发展的方向进行人力资源分配和人才规划，促进区域健康良性发展，建立人才梯队，保留高绩效人才。 6. 通过跟进计划，各团队的工作汇报和和随访等，深入了解各个团队的工作进展并进行针对性的辅导，包括业务及市场活动，人员管理和辅导，人才发展和保留等工作。 7. 根据对市场发展趋势的分析，挖掘区域市场机会，打造大区的长期竞争优势。 8. 协调并组织大区内的重要项目及活动，合理分配和控制各项资源。 9. 与区域内关键客户保持持续的沟通，前瞻性预测客户学术需求的变化，建立并持续优化战略合作伙伴关系。 10. 熟悉对当前及未来业务有影响的政策，必要情况下可根据公司的要求，与相关职能部门合作，参与或协调所辖区域的市场准入工作。 11. 建立和保持有效沟通系统，包括定期召开大区会议，定期与上级汇报区域工作进展，与其他部门建立跨部门沟通和合作关系。 12. 为制订和修改业务相关的政策和流程及其他内部政策提供建议，以实现高效率的业务运作。 13. 支持公司的各项创新举措，带领大区各个团队执行新举措，搭建创新平台。 14. 完成上级经理指派的其他各项工作。 任职要求 教育： - 大学本科及以上学历，医学，药学，生命科学等相关专业优先。 技能： - 熟练使用MS Office，英语良好。 - 具备较好的相关产品领域的专业知识。 - 具备较强的领导力和战略思维能力。 - 具备较强的沟通，计划，组织和问题解决能力。 - 具备较强的团队合作意识。 - 具备较强的学习意愿和学习能力。 - 善于自我激励，自我挑战和管理压力。 经验： - 至少 3 年制药行业同等公司的业务管理工作经验，具备符合合规要求的，优秀的绩效记录。 诚信： - 能够严格管理自己的行为，确保日常工作全部遵循公司政策、行业准则以及相关法律，包括但不限于 FCPA (《反海外腐败法》)及相关中国大陆境内相关反腐法律条款。严守诚信，保持真实透明，在过往的工作中无任何违反法律规定的行为发生。 内部申请资格： - 内部申请人需符合现行合规调查流程，处分等级&时限等的要求。 - 至少有 2 年辉瑞业务管理工作经验。 - 过去两年的团队绩效，需达到或超过团队平均水平。 核心能力 专业合规: 构建专业体系-在大区内建立专业能力标准体系，通过流程和机制提升团队整体的专业能力。 营造合规氛围-准确理解合规各项规定的意义和原则，培养团队合规意识，规范团队合规行为，防范合规风险。 业务决断: 策略规划业务-策略性地规划大区的业务发展，在抓住市场机会的同时持续打造大区的长期竞争优势。宏观掌控市场-通过数据分析，通盘掌握大区整体市场的变化，并对市场趋势进行预判。 客户融动: 优化合作策略-预测大区客户需求的变化，建立战略合作伙伴关系，通过策略性合作提升辉瑞竞争优势。建立协作机制-建立并优化合作机制，为协作建立共同的目标，并积极推动持续的跨部门沟通和合作。 组织发展: 营造正向氛围-激发团队信息，营造积极的团队氛围。 搭建人才梯队-通过系统的培养体系提升大区人员的能力，搭建人才梯队。 自主执行: 建立执行机制-在大区内建立和推广高效执行的标准和全面管理机制，在系统及机制层面提升执行效果。勇于全面担责-对于大区的绩效承担最终责任，主动设定挑战性目标促进工作不断优化。 自我发展: 全面完善自我-审视职业理想和目标，寻求和创造学习机会以促进全面素养的提升。 创新变革: 搭建创新平台-主动探索创新和变革的机会，营造创新变革环境，并推动团队变革。 Pfizer is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable equal employment opportunity legislation in each jurisdiction in which it operates. As a Process Support Engineer (PSE), you'll play a critical role in guiding products through their entire lifecycle, from initial concept to final qualification. You will provide high-visibility customer support through on-site installations, system diagnoses, and the service and repair of complex systems and equipment. PSEs work closely with customers and R&D teams to develop leading-edge processes used to manufacture advanced semiconductor chips, and create hypothesis experiments and design of experiments (DOEs). You'll analyze data with statistics and compile reports with high-level conclusions on technically challenging process engineering experiments. Additionally, you will troubleshoot complex problems, perform root cause analyses, and resolve difficult process engineering and customer product issues. Process Support Engineers work across technologies such as: Chemical Vapor Deposition, Atomic Layer Deposition, Plasma Reactive Ion Etch, Physical Vapor Deposition, Anneal and Implant.  
 Role Responsibilities:   
 Provide high-visibility customer support through on-site installations, system diagnoses, and the service and repair of complex systems and equipment 
 Work closely with the customer to develop leading-edge processes used to manufacture the most advanced semiconductor chips, many of which are inside everyday electronic devices 
 Create hypothesis experiments and design of experiments (DOE); analyze data with statistics; and compile reports with high-level conclusions on technically challenging process engineering experiments 
 Troubleshoot complex problems; perform multiple root cause analysis; and resolve a variety of difficult process engineering and customer product issues  
 Communicate with both internal stakeholders and the customer to achieve goals with a focus on building relationships and establishing trust 
 Apply your growing knowledge of the company’s processes and customers to help solve a range of problems and analyze possible solutions 
 Minimum Qualifications: 
 Bachelor’s degree in chemistry/ physics, materials engineering, electrical engineering, optoelectronics or related field 
 2–4 years of experience in the semiconductor fab or equipment industry  
 Communication proficiency in English language
 Preferred Qualifications:   
 Master’s degree or PhD in a related field

As a Field Service Engineer [Customer Engineer] at Applied Materials, you serve as the direct liaison with customers, collaborating closely to install, maintain, and upgrade equipment. You'll use digital analytics for troubleshooting and apply basic diagnostic techniques to assess and address technical issues. Your responsibilities include performing preventative and corrective maintenance on various systems such as electrical, vacuum, mechanical, plasma, hydraulic, and gas systems. Additionally, you'll coordinate and communicate directly with customers to ensure smooth operations and exceptional service.  
 Role Responsibilities:   
 Collaborate with Senior Field Service Engineers [Customer Engineers] in installing, maintaining, and upgrading customer equipment
 Use digital analytics for troubleshooting   
 Apply basic diagnostic techniques to assess equipment and address technical issues, with guidance from Senior Field Service Engineers [Customer Engineers]
 Perform preventative and corrective maintenance on electrical, vacuum, mechanical, plasma, hydraulic, and gas systems (training provided)
 Coordinate and communicate directly with customers
 Fulfill additional duties, as assigned
 Minimum Qualifications:   
 Completion of an Associate degree, military technical training, field service experience, or trade certification
 1–2 years of work experience in customer/field service support, or a related technical field
 Ability to read and interpret electrical and mechanical schematics
 Experience diagnosing and resolving basic technical challenges
 Basic mechanical aptitude with pneumatics, hydraulics, electronics, vacuum, or thermodynamics
 Familiarity with hand tools and their appropriate usage, including digital multimeters
 Effective written and verbal communication skills
 Basic knowledge of Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint   
 Possession of a valid driver’s license and the ability to obtain a passport, if travel is required.
 Able to meet all on-site requirements, including safety, environmental guidelines, and COVID-19 protocols
 Preferred Qualifications:   
 2–4 years of work experience in customer/field service support, or a related technical field
 Physical Requirements:   
This position often requires extensive walking, standing for extended periods of time, working in tight spaces, bending, squatting, twisting, kneeling, reaching, climbing stairs and ladders, working at height, lifting up to 35 lbs., the ability to distinguish between colors and working with electricity, the ability to work in an environment with noise that may be difficult for some individuals with sensitivity to noise, and the use of hand and power tools.   Additionally, because this position generally involves working in a clean room, it requires the use of appropriate Personal Protective Equipment such as coveralls, hoods, booties, safety glasses, gloves, respirators, chemical aprons, and face shields.

As a Process Support Engineer (PSE), you'll play a critical role in guiding products through their entire lifecycle, from initial concept to final qualification. You will provide high-visibility customer support through on-site installations, system diagnoses, and the service and repair of complex systems and equipment. PSEs work closely with customers and R&D teams to develop leading-edge processes used to manufacture advanced semiconductor chips, and create hypothesis experiments and design of experiments (DOEs). You'll analyze data with statistics and compile reports with high-level conclusions on technically challenging process engineering experiments. Additionally, you will troubleshoot complex problems, perform root cause analyses, and resolve difficult process engineering and customer product issues. Process Support Engineers work across technologies such as: Chemical Vapor Deposition, Atomic Layer Deposition, Plasma Reactive Ion Etch, Physical Vapor Deposition, Anneal and Implant.  
 Role Responsibilities:   
 Provide high-visibility customer support through on-site installations, system diagnoses, and the service and repair of complex systems and equipment 
 Work closely with the customer to develop leading-edge processes used to manufacture the most advanced semiconductor chips, many of which are inside everyday electronic devices 
 Create hypothesis experiments and design of experiments (DOE); analyze data with statistics; and compile reports with high-level conclusions on technically challenging process engineering experiments 
 Troubleshoot complex problems; perform multiple root cause analysis; and resolve a variety of difficult process engineering and customer product issues  
 Communicate with both internal stakeholders and the customer to achieve goals with a focus on building relationships and establishing trust 
 Apply your growing knowledge of best practices to offer a new perspective using existing solutions  
 Serve as a resource for junior colleagues and a liaison between the customer and business unit; you may also lead small projects with manageable risks and resource requirements 
 Minimum Qualifications: 
 Bachelor’s degree in chemistry/ physics, materials engineering, electrical engineering, optoelectronics or related field 
 4–7 years of experience in the semiconductor fab or equipment industry  
 Strong interpersonal and communication skills to explain sensitive information and work to build consensus among project stakeholders 
 Communication proficiency in English language
 Preferred Qualifications: 
 Master’s degree or PhD in a related field

Yes, 20% of the Time

As a Field Service Engineer [Customer Engineer] at Applied Materials, you serve as the direct liaison with customers, collaborating closely to install, maintain, and upgrade equipment. You'll use digital analytics for troubleshooting and apply basic diagnostic techniques to assess and address technical issues. Your responsibilities include performing preventative and corrective maintenance on various systems such as electrical, vacuum, mechanical, plasma, hydraulic, and gas systems. Additionally, you'll coordinate and communicate directly with customers to ensure smooth operations and exceptional service.  
 Role Responsibilities:   
 Collaborate with Senior Field Service Engineers [Customer Engineers] in installing, maintaining, and upgrading customer equipment
 Use digital analytics for troubleshooting   
 Apply basic diagnostic techniques to assess equipment and address technical issues, with guidance from Senior Field Service Engineers [Customer Engineers]
 Perform preventative and corrective maintenance on electrical, vacuum, mechanical, plasma, hydraulic, and gas systems (training provided)
 Coordinate and communicate directly with customers
 Fulfill additional duties, as assigned
 Minimum Qualifications:   
 Completion of an Associate degree, military technical training, field service experience, or trade certification
 1–2 years of work experience in customer/field service support, or a related technical field
 Ability to read and interpret electrical and mechanical schematics
 Experience diagnosing and resolving basic technical challenges
 Basic mechanical aptitude with pneumatics, hydraulics, electronics, vacuum, or thermodynamics
 Familiarity with hand tools and their appropriate usage, including digital multimeters
 Effective written and verbal communication skills
 Basic knowledge of Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint   
 Possession of a valid driver’s license and the ability to obtain a passport, if travel is required.
 Able to meet all on-site requirements, including safety, environmental guidelines, and COVID-19 protocols
 Preferred Qualifications:   
 2–4 years of work experience in customer/field service support, or a related technical field
 Physical Requirements:   
This position often requires extensive walking, standing for extended periods of time, working in tight spaces, bending, squatting, twisting, kneeling, reaching, climbing stairs and ladders, working at height, lifting up to 35 lbs., the ability to distinguish between colors and working with electricity, the ability to work in an environment with noise that may be difficult for some individuals with sensitivity to noise, and the use of hand and power tools.   Additionally, because this position generally involves working in a clean room, it requires the use of appropriate Personal Protective Equipment such as coveralls, hoods, booties, safety glasses, gloves, respirators, chemical aprons, and face shields.

Assignee / Regular

Yes, 75% of the Time

Yes

Job Description MAIN REPONSIBILITIES / DUTIES Maximize the value of Pfizer products to Chinese patients and health care professional within Pfizer’s vision and mission. Develop KOL engagement strategy and action plan. Establish regional platform and channel with China regional academic organization in defined therapeutic area for knowledge delivery and interaction. Build effective regional medical advisor interface and provide professional medical training to support filed force teams independently. All the above duties will be carried out under the guidance of MSL Manager or Medical Affairs Lead. 1. Develop field based medical to medical communication and KOL engagement independently l Lead mapping/profiling of regional level KOLs. l Develop medical to medical communication with regional level KOLs for knowledge delivery and interaction of defined therapeutic area and assigned products and gain insights. l Establish good academic relationship with regional academic organization at defined therapeutic area. l Organize and lead regional level medical to medical meeting with KOLs for knowledge delivery and interaction of defined therapeutic area and assigned products. l Cooperate with local regional medical societies to conduct medical programs/conference to facilitate new concept and state of art medical progress’ introduction. l Speak at medical communication meeting at national and regional level as needed. 2. Enhance local data generation from medical aspect to maximize products’ value and long-term development l Discuss research concept with interested researcher and communicated the nature and requirement of Pfizer’s data generation. l Facilitate submission of investigator initiated or collaboration pre-clinical and clinical proposals, and act as a liaison between Pfizer and researcher. l Support in review and track new data generation projects independently with good quality and required timeline. l Support Pfizer sponsored Non interventional study and other data generation projects if applicable. 3. Drive regional medical strategy independently l Develop regional medical strategy for inline/pipeline product life cycle management. l Collect, analyze and report timely regional medical insights to input on medical strategy and message development. l Initiate and lead medical programs independently at regional level with internal and external customers to assist deliver medical strategy. 4. Ensure company’s compliance. l Support MAPP review to ensure educational/enterprise grants within medical compliance as needed. l Support in review and approval of promotional materials as needed. l Implement medical programs and activities within medical compliance. l Comunicate medical information with compliance. 5. Develop filed force team medical capability through internal medical training independently l Initiate and implement independently medical training to strengthen filed force colleagues’ product and therapeutic areas knowledge at regional level. l Provide customized response for common medical queries in the field for assigned products. REQUIRED SKILL SET Technical Therapeutic area knowledge: familiar with the disease knowledge and clinical practice of the therapeutic area. Language: Proficiency in oral and written English. Good understanding about pharmaceutical business Computer: Familiar with Microsoft Office software (e.g. Word, Excel and PowerPoint). Strong business acumen. Cross functional leadership skill. Strong communication and influencing skill. Behavior Sustain focus on performance. Manage change. Seeks opportunities to receive and provide knowledge and leading practices. Align across Pfizer. Certifications N/A Education Master’s degree or higher in clinical medicine in relevant therapeutic area. Experience Good medical knowledge for the defined therapeutic area. Good understanding about pharmaceutical business. Proficiency in English and good computer usage. job_description_raw: Director, Technology Adoption, Engagement & Transformation — China Role Snapshot Function / Team: Commercial Excellence & Innovation (CEI) - Digital & Technology (Technology Adoption, Engagement & Transformation) Location: China Grade / Level: Director Reports to: Digital & Technology Head (D&T Head) 1. Role Summary The Director leads the market-facing technology adoption, engagement and transformation capability for CEI Digital & Technology. The role ensures existing systems and new AI-enabled products are directed toward measurable outcomes, CEI PODs are formed around clear opportunities, and adoption and transformation continue through scale and sustainable ownership. 2. Key Accountabilities Translate CEI and Business Unit priorities into an integrated technology adoption, roadmap, demand and portfolio agenda aligned with global D&T. Own senior technology engagement and transformation for legacy and AI-enabled products and carry market signals into intake, prioritization and POD formation. Lead technology product and portfolio lifecycle decisions using reuse-before-build and operate, modernize, industrialize or retire choices. Shape business and operating-model transformation by connecting technology, workflow redesign, change, adoption and value realization. Lead experience and workflow design across customer and colleague journeys, user experience, agent hand-offs and Business Unit adaptation. Establish adoption telemetry, service integration and an integrated service catalogue, using platform usage and user insight to improve adoption and outcomes. Coordinate Legal, Privacy, Risk, Compliance and Security clearance as lifecycle stage gates and provide a clear D&T liaison for governance stakeholders. Lead technology scouting and assess emerging technologies for strategic relevance and business value. Enable POD effectiveness through clear outcomes, product ownership, stakeholder alignment, adoption planning and transition to sustainable ownership. Own the market-facing engagement model for CEI D&T — running a structured operating rhythm with Business Units and CEI capabilities to surface demand, align priorities and drive adoption of technology and AI-enabled products. 3. Required Capabilities & Competencies (a) Critical Capabilities & Qualifications Technology stack and adoption, business engagement, transformation leadership, product and portfolio lifecycle and executive stakeholder management. Experience and workflow design, adoption and change, telemetry, service integration and technology scouting. Legal, privacy, risk and compliance coordination, POD operating models and value realization. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Digital Business or Design or a closely related discipline; an advanced technical or business degree is preferred. Typically, 15+ years of progressive relevant experience, including several years leading teams and delivery at scope and complexity appropriate to similar level. Demonstrated ability to work across business, product, technology, data and governance stakeholders in a matrixed environment. Experience in a highly regulated industry and the China technology, data, privacy or vendor environment is preferred. (b) Leadership Expectations Outcome ownership: connects decisions to measurable business, user, service and transformation outcomes. AI-first and enterprise-minded: applies responsible AI, reuse, architecture, security, privacy and scale principles appropriate to the work. POD collaboration: enables clear accountability, effective cross-functional execution and minimal handoff friction across peer teams and partners. Precision and learning: communicate clearly, documents decisions, uses evidence and telemetry and continuously improves delivery. Transformation leadership: connects business ambition, experience, adoption, portfolio choices and measurable value realization. 4. Key Collaboration The Director maintains strong partnership with Go-to-Market Transformation (GTMx), AI transformation office (AITO), Global Commercial Analytics (GCA) and the Chief Marketing Office (CMO), Pfizer Innovation Center (PIC), China Business Units or functions, and peer D&T team leads, carrying market signals into intake, prioritization and POD formation. The role provides a clear D&T liaison for Legal, Privacy, Risk, Compliance and Security governance stakeholders, and works with relevant global D&T teams. It also partners with China CEI leadership and POD owners to align technology portfolio and transformation with commercial priorities. 5. Measures of Success Clear alignment of technology portfolio and investment with CEI and Business Unit priorities. Higher adoption and measurable value from legacy and AI-enabled products. Effective POD initiation, stakeholder alignment and transition into scale and sustainable ownership. Timely governance clearance and improved product lifecycle discipline, user experience and workflow outcomes. job_description_raw: Position Summary The GE Marketing Lead - Metabolism is responsible for driving the strategic planning, launch excellence, and long-term growth of Pfizer's metabolic portfolio across broad-market China, with a primary focus on diabetes, obesity diseases. This role will lead the development and execution of innovative go-to-market strategies, accelerate market access and HCP engagement, build scalable healthcare ecosystem platforms, and ensure strong cross-functional collaboration to maximize business impact. The position requires deep expertise in metabolic diseases and demonstrated success in launching or managing diabetes, obesity, GLP-1RA, or related cardiometabolic brands. Key Responsibilities 1. Portfolio Strategy & Brand Leadership Lead strategic planning and lifecycle management of the metabolic portfolio. Develop annual business plans, launch strategies, and growth initiatives aligned with business objectives. Identify market opportunities through customer, patient, competitor, and policy insights. Translate brand strategy into actionable field execution plans and measurable business outcomes. 2. Launch Excellence & Go-to-Market Development Drive successful launch and commercialization of innovative metabolic products. Design differentiated go-to-market models for broad-market and county-level healthcare settings. Build customer engagement strategies across Endocrinology, General Practice, Nutrition, Obesity Management, and other relevant specialties. Develop scalable models to accelerate adoption, access, and physician preference. 3. Healthcare Ecosystem & Platform Building Lead development of strategic healthcare ecosystem initiatives, including PPP and disease management platforms. Establish partnerships with key hospitals, academic societies, and healthcare stakeholders. Promote integrated patient management pathways for diabetes and obesity care. Generate real-world experience and best-practice models to support long-term brand growth. 4. Cross-functional Leadership Partner closely with Medical, Access, Sales, Commercial Excellence, Digital, and other teams. Ensure One Pfizer collaboration to align resources and accelerate business execution. Drive operational excellence, resource prioritization, and ROI optimization. 5. Market Insights & Performance Management Monitor competitive landscape, reimbursement policies, and market dynamics. Utilize data analytics to identify growth opportunities and guide investment decisions. Define and track key business KPIs, including: Market share growth Hospital access expansion Physician adoption Patient initiation Brand awareness and preference Real-world evidence generation 6. Team Leadership & Talent Development Build and develop a high-performing marketing organization. Coach and mentor team members to strengthen strategic thinking and execution capabilities. Foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and accountability. Qualifications Education Bachelor's degree or above in Medicine, Pharmacy, Life Sciences, Public Health, Business, or related disciplines. MBA or advanced healthcare-related degree preferred. Experience Minimum 8-10 years of pharmaceutical industry experience. Mandatory Therapeutic Area Expertise Strong metabolic disease background is required , including demonstrated experience in one or more of the following areas: Type 2 Diabetes (T2D) Obesity / Chronic Weight Management (CWM) GLP-1 Receptor Agonists Endocrinology Pfizer is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable equal employment opportunity legislation in each jurisdiction in which it operates. job_description_raw: 职责概述 医学信息沟通专员在医学信息沟通地区经理的领导和辅导下，负责所辖区域内的产品学术推广和客户专业支持，如拜访客户传递 / 沟通 / 反馈药品信息、召开产品学术推广活动等，从而实现工作目标（包括但不限于专业技能、行为、合规及业绩等综合考评目标）。 主要工作和任务 1. 在公司政策和程序指引下向客户提供及时准确的专业支持，建立合作伙伴关系。 2. 在公司政策和程序指引下充分利用资源进行有效的客户拜访，实现工作目标。 3. 在公司政策和程序指引下规划和组织各种学术会议或活动。 4. 通过公司管理系统以及其他合规的渠道和方式，收集市场和客户反馈的信息，进行分析，反馈和建议。 5. 与上级经理，同事和其他部门的业务伙伴保持有效的联络，发现和促进各种合作机会。 6. 在上级经理的辅导下，把握各种学习机会不断提升专业知识和能力。 7. 执行公司推行的各项新举措，在公司政策和程序引导下探索创新和优化的机会。 8. 完成上级经理指派的其他各项工作。 任职要求 · 教育： - 具有医学、药学或相关专业大学专科及以上学历。 · 技能： - 熟练使用 MS Office ，英语良好。 - 具有较强的沟通能力和团队合作意识。 - 具备较强的学习意愿和学习能力。 - 善于自我激励，自我挑战和管理压力。 · 经验 ： - 医药行业相关工作经验优先。 · 诚信： - 能够严格管理自己的行为，确保日常工作全部遵循公司政策、行业准则以及相关法律，包括但不限于 FCPA ( 《反海外腐败法》 ) 及相关中国大陆境内相关反腐法律条款。严守诚信，保持真实透 明，在过往的工作中无任何违反法律规定的行为发生。 · 内部申请资格： - 内部申请人需符合合规调查流程，处分等级 & 时限等要求。 核心能力 专业合规 : 坚持专业推广 - 掌握并正确运用产品，治疗，疾病领域的知识，面对客户展现专业形象。严格坚守合规 - 工作中严格遵从合规要求，及时澄清问题并报告有合规风险的行为。 业务决断 : 把握市场动态 - 随时把握市场动态，并且能敏锐地发现学术推广机会。 有效利用信息 - 合法合规地收集和运用信息，有理有据地分析并从中挖掘学术推广机会。 客户融动 : 提供专业支持 - 积极与外部客户，包括医生，专家和其他合作伙伴进行互动，快速响应客户的学术需求，准确及时地提供专业支持。 主动促进合作 - 对内部客户主动沟通，寻求机会促进相互理解，建立合作关系。 自主执行 : 高效准确执行 - 及时准确不打折扣地执行各项工作。 主动承担任务 - 对待工作认真负责，有始有终，遇到问题主动承担，遇到困难坚持达成目标。 自我发展 : 主动提升能力 - 把握内外部各种学习机会和资源，不断提升自身的能力和适应力。 创新变革 : 积极拥抱变化 - 用开放的心态面对创新和变化，积极尝试新方法。 Pfizer is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable equal employment opportunity legislation in each jurisdiction in which it operates. normalized_title: Analyst Accounting, Capital Assets & Leases APAC
normalized_title_en: Analyst Accounting, Capital Assets & Leases APAC
job_description_raw:
Job Purpose and Impact 
 The Analyst Accounting, Capital Assets & Leases APAC  job performs routine record to report activities to collect, process and present accurate financial data for the purposes of providing external information for decision making while ensuring compliance with financial transaction recording standards. Under close supervision, this job collaborates with businesses and banks to complete standard operational processes and procedures, compliance and data management for financial products and services and data systems. This job also supports improvements in process execution and audit activities.
 Key Accountabilities 
 RECORD TO REPORT ACTIVITIES: Performs routine activities, including processing journal entries and intercompany transactions, completing monthly and quarterly general ledger close activities, performing fixed asset accounting, balance sheet reconciliations and reporting activities, tax accounting, cost and profit center allocation, bank accounting and bank reconciliations. 
 FOREX RISK MANAGEMENT: Assists with foreign exchange risk management for selected units, including activities related to foreign exchange exposures, foreign exchange risks, and risk management procedures and processes to ensure adherence to policies. 
 POLICY COMPLIANCE & CONSISTENCY: Maintains the standard operating procedures and processes, and helps monitor operational compliance with financial transaction recording standards, including company accounting policies, statutory reporting regulations and tax regulations. 
 BUSINESS PARTNERSHIP: Supports positive relationship with customers, clients and other business partners, responding to business contacts or customers directly to deliver accurate processes. 
 PROCESS EXECUTION IMPROVEMENT: Applies basic knowledge of operational practices, procedures and internal controls to identify improvement opportunities in execution to drive operational excellence and data integrity to enable analysis and insight. 
 Qualifications 
 Strong knowledge of fixed asset accounting principles and processes.
 3-4 years of relevant Fixed Asset accounting experience; exceptional candidates may be considered with less experience.
 Strong communication skills, Continuous improvement mindset. 
 Korean language proficiency is a plus for this role.

job_description_raw:
Job Purpose and Impact 
 The position will provide assistance to the team for complex administrative tasks for the coordination of sourcing contract related activities by following the established guidelines. In this role, you will partner with related stakeholders to support the process of contract creations and amendments in related systems. You will collaborate with internal business and external suppliers to maintain contract data in the database to ensure compliance with appropriate guidelines.
 Key Accountabilities 
 Partner with relevant stakeholders to provide assistance on pending contract items and organize them in the database.
 Provide support to the team to ensure contract compliance with established guidelines by maintaining the mandatory items using the approved contract template and collecting queries or escalations raised.
 Collect and organize complex administrative reports on contract analysis for the defined area.
 Maintain, review and analyze operational contracts for goods and services assigned, including contract items, pricing, terms and conditions and ensure new data element is in the information systems.
 Provide assistance to assigned projects and support deployments related to sourcing contract management.
 Handle complex clerical, administrative, technical or customer support issues under minimal supervision, while escalating only the most complex issues to appropriate staff.
 Other duties as assigned
 Qualifications 
 Minimum Qualifications High school diploma, secondary education level or equivalent
 Thai & English skills
 Prefer to have procurement and SAP related experience
 Other minimum qualifications may apply

job_description_raw: 职责概述 医学信息沟通专员在医学信息沟通地区经理的领导和辅导下，负责所辖区域内的产品学术推广和客户专业支持，如拜访客户传递 / 沟通 / 反馈药品信息、召开产品学术推广活动等，从而实现工作目标（包括但不限于专业技能、行为、合规及业绩等综合考评目标）。 主要工作和任务 1. 在公司政策和程序指引下向客户提供及时准确的专业支持，建立合作伙伴关系。 2. 在公司政策和程序指引下充分利用资源进行有效的客户拜访，实现工作目标。 3. 在公司政策和程序指引下规划和组织各种学术会议或活动。 4. 通过公司管理系统以及其他合规的渠道和方式，收集市场和客户反馈的信息，进行分析，反馈和建议。 5. 与上级经理，同事和其他部门的业务伙伴保持有效的联络，发现和促进各种合作机会。 6. 在上级经理的辅导下，把握各种学习机会不断提升专业知识和能力。 7. 执行公司推行的各项新举措，在公司政策和程序引导下探索创新和优化的机会。 8. 完成上级经理指派的其他各项工作。 任职要求 · 教育： - 具有医学、药学或相关专业大学专科及以上学历。 · 技能： - 熟练使用 MS Office ，英语良好。 - 具有较强的沟通能力和团队合作意识。 - 具备较强的学习意愿和学习能力。 - 善于自我激励，自我挑战和管理压力。 · 经验 ： - 医药行业相关工作经验优先。 · 诚信： - 能够严格管理自己的行为，确保日常工作全部遵循公司政策、行业准则以及相关法律，包括但不限于 FCPA ( 《反海外腐败法》 ) 及相关中国大陆境内相关反腐法律条款。严守诚信，保持真实透 明，在过往的工作中无任何违反法律规定的行为发生。 · 内部申请资格： - 内部申请人需符合合规调查流程，处分等级 & 时限等要求。 核心能力 专业合规 : 坚持专业推广 - 掌握并正确运用产品，治疗，疾病领域的知识，面对客户展现专业形象。严格坚守合规 - 工作中严格遵从合规要求，及时澄清问题并报告有合规风险的行为。 业务决断 : 把握市场动态 - 随时把握市场动态，并且能敏锐地发现学术推广机会。 有效利用信息 - 合法合规地收集和运用信息，有理有据地分析并从中挖掘学术推广机会。 客户融动 : 提供专业支持 - 积极与外部客户，包括医生，专家和其他合作伙伴进行互动，快速响应客户的学术需求，准确及时地提供专业支持。 主动促进合作 - 对内部客户主动沟通，寻求机会促进相互理解，建立合作关系。 自主执行 : 高效准确执行 - 及时准确不打折扣地执行各项工作。 主动承担任务 - 对待工作认真负责，有始有终，遇到问题主动承担，遇到困难坚持达成目标。 自我发展 : 主动提升能力 - 把握内外部各种学习机会和资源，不断提升自身的能力和适应力。 创新变革 : 积极拥抱变化 - 用开放的心态面对创新和变化，积极尝试新方法。 Pfizer is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable equal employment opportunity legislation in each jurisdiction in which it operates.  Applied Materials is the global leader in materials science and engineering solutions that are at the foundation of virtually every new semiconductor chip and advanced display in the world.  What We Offer

Beijing,CHN, Chengdu,CHN, Dalian,CHN, Hefei,CHN, Shanghai,CHN, Shenzhen,CHN, Wuhan,CHN, Wuxi,CHN, Xi'an,CHN

 TSEs provide technical support remotely, and on site, to FSO personnel for highly complex problems involving equipment malfunction, on wafer issues, and performance enhancement programs where first-line product support was unable to isolate or fix a problem. Using advanced troubleshooting methodologies, they establish success criteria, develop comprehensive action plans, analyze and compile findings, perform root cause analysis and support FSO repair activities through escalation closure. 
 Responsible for technical escalations (remote & onsite) at customer sites for DDP [CVD] products, able to use a systematic approach to problem solving and use data driven troubleshooting and diagnostic tools.
 Support and provide technical feedback to improve fleet performance, improvement programs and upgrades.
 Guide and coach field engineers in troubleshooting techniques, work ethics and cultural norms.
 Develop troubleshooting guides and support technical documentation to enhance field engineers’ knowledge.
 Key Responsibilities:   
 Support multiple technical escalations, resolve with focus on time to resolution and quality of work 
 Attend customer field issues meetings with FSO, collaborate with BU engineers  
 Recommend best practices to improve products, processes, or services. 
 Publishing Technical Lessons Learned, troubleshooting guides, technical (ET) papers, etc. 
 Provide on-site coaching to FSO   
 Support NPI development early in the product life cycle, and at key customer sites 
 Create, or collaborate in creation of, innovative advanced trouble shooting tools   
 Business Expertise:   
 Has knowledge of best practices and how own area integrates with others; is aware of the competition and the factors that differentiate them in the market.  
 Leadership:   
 Provides coaching to colleagues with less experience; may lead small projects with manageable risks and resource requirements. 
 Problem Solving:   
 Solves complex problems; takes a new perspective on existing solutions; exercises judgment based on the analysis of multiple sources of information and data. 
 Impact:   
 Impacts a range of customer, operational, project or service activities within own team and other related teams; works within broad guidelines and policies. 
 Interpersonal Skills:   
 Explains difficult or sensitive information; works to build consensus. Manage difficult situations in stressful environments. 
 Qualifications   
 1) Education: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in technical field   
 2) Skills
 - Ability to work independently and as part of a team
 - Strong Organizational and time management skills
 - Excellent interpersonal and communication skills
 - Ability to handle stressful situations and effectively manage difficult problem
 - Familiar with suite of Microsoft Apps, and internal ones such as SAP, VSPI and ARK.
 3) Year of Experience: +7 years of experience with Applied Materials DDP products or similar.
 Additional Information 
 Travel - Generally 25% of the time, but could be as high as 50%

job_description_raw: Retail & E-commerce Metabolic Strategy & Operations Lead 零售及电商代谢战略运营负责人 Location: Beijing / Shanghai Therapy Area Focus: Overweight & Obesity (GLP-1) ROLE SUMMARY The Retail & E-commerce Metabolic Strategy & Operations Lead supports the development and execution of the overall retail and e-commerce business strategy for the metabolic portfolio. The role integrates strategic planning, business performance management, commercial insights and operational coordination to enable informed decision-making and sustainable business growth. Working closely with Retail Metabolic Marketing / Brand Managers, E-commerce Channel Teams and cross-functional stakeholders, this role translates market intelligence and business performance data into actionable priorities, strengthens strategic alignment and facilitates the delivery of key business initiatives. The role provides strategic and operational oversight, while dedicated Project Managers own day-to-day project coordination and delivery. ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES • Business Strategy & Planning: Support integrated retail and e-commerce strategic planning, annual business priorities and growth opportunity assessments; translate strategic objectives into clear business plans and actionable priorities. • Business Performance Management: Establish and maintain business performance dashboards and KPI frameworks; monitor channel performance, commercial drivers and progress against business priorities, providing management with data-driven recommendations. • Market Intelligence & Strategic Insights: Analyze retail and e-commerce market dynamics, competition, channel trends, and consumer and patient journey insights to identify opportunities and inform strategic decisions. • Cross-functional Alignment & Operational Excellence: Facilitate alignment across Retail Marketing, E-commerce and relevant enabling functions; support business reviews, operational planning, resource prioritization and continuous improvement of ways of working. • Strategic Initiative Execution & Governance: Track the progress, milestones and business impact of priority strategic initiatives; help remove cross-functional barriers and maintain alignment with business objectives in collaboration with responsible project owners and Project Managers. PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE & EDUCATIONAL REQUIREMENTS • Strategic Thinking & Structured Problem-Solving: Ability to structure ambiguous commercial questions, evaluate strategic options and convert analysis into business recommendations. • Business Planning & Performance Management: Experience supporting business strategy, commercial planning, KPI development, performance tracking and management reviews. • Retail & E-commerce Business Acumen: Strong understanding of retail and digital commerce business models, channel dynamics and commercial performance drivers; familiarity with obesity or metabolic care journeys is an advantage. • Market Intelligence & Analytical Rigor: Proven ability to synthesize market, competitive, customer and commercial data into clear, executive-ready insights. • Cross-functional Influence & Communication: Strong stakeholder management, communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to influence without direct authority. • Execution & Operational Excellence: Ability to coordinate priorities, establish effective operating rhythms and monitor strategic initiative outcomes in a regulated business environment. Experience: • 10+ years of relevant professional experience, including 7+ years in business strategy, commercial operations, management consulting, market insights or related roles. • Healthcare or pharmaceutical industry experience strongly preferred; experience in retail and/or e-commerce channels is an advantage. • Experience with business performance analytics, strategic planning and cross-functional stakeholder engagement preferred. Education: Bachelor's degree required; an advanced degree (MBA, MS or equivalent) is preferred. job_description_raw: JOB SUMMARY As the EC Customer Engagement Lead of Ali Health , you will own the metabolic business strategy, strategic platform partnerships, and overall commercial performance of the JD/Ali channel. You will shape the channel growth agenda, integrate platform and internal resources, guide the JD/Ali E-commerce Manager, and ensure compliant execution to strengthen patient access and deliver sustainable business growth. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES · Channel Strategy & Business Planning: Own metabolic channel strategy, annual and quarterly business plans, commercial priorities and channel targets, aligning platform opportunities with the retail and e-commerce business strategy. · Strategic Partnership & Resource Integration: Lead JD/Ali platform partnerships, commercial negotiations and joint business planning; secure appropriate platform resources and coordinate Marketing, Medical, Finance, Supply Chain and other relevant stakeholders. · Business Performance & Growth: Account for overall JD/Ali channel performance; monitor revenue, market share, channel effectiveness and investment efficiency, and initiate corrective actions where required. · Commercial Innovation & Patient Access: Identify compliant opportunities for new customer engagement, digital services, access pathways and commercial innovation within the JD/Ali ecosystem. · Team Leadership & Execution Oversight: Provide direction, coaching and performance guidance to the JD/Ali E-commerce Manager; oversee key commercial campaigns and ensure delivery against business priorities. · Market Intelligence & Compliance: Monitor customer, platform and competitive trends while ensuring all channel activities comply with applicable policies, laws and internal governance. EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE · Bachelor's degree or above; marketing, business, healthcare or a related discipline preferred. · Typically 10+ years of relevant commercial experience, including substantial pharmaceutical/healthcare e-commerce, platform partnership or channel leadership exposure. · Demonstrated JD/Ali platform experience and strong understanding of pharmaceutical e-commerce business models, operations and regulatory requirements. · Proven ability to lead business planning, external partnerships, cross-functional alignment and commercial performance management. SKILLS REQUIREMENTS · Strong strategic thinking, business judgment, stakeholder influence and cross-functional collaboration. · Excellent communication and presentation skills in Chinese and English. · Strong execution, planning, problem-solving and adaptability in a dynamic commercial environment. INTEGRITY & COMPLIANCE Perform all responsibilities in accordance with Pfizer policies, applicable laws, industry codes and internal approval processes. Maintain integrity, transparency and appropriate handling of patient and business information. job_description_raw: JOB SUMMARY As the EC Channel Lead of Innovation Business, you will own the metabolic business strategy, strategic platform partnerships, and overall commercial performance of the channel. You will shape the channel growth agenda, integrate platform and internal resources, ensure compliant execution to strengthen patient access and deliver sustainable business growth. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES · Channel Strategy & Business Planning: Own metabolic channel strategy, annual and quarterly business plans, commercial priorities and channel targets, aligning platform opportunities with the retail and e-commerce business strategy. · Strategic Partnership & Resource Integration: Lead platform partnerships, commercial negotiations and joint business planning; secure appropriate platform resources and coordinate Marketing, Medical, Finance, Supply Chain and other relevant stakeholders. · Business Performance & Growth: Account for overall channel performance; monitor revenue, market share, channel effectiveness and investment efficiency, and initiate corrective actions where required. · Commercial Innovation & Patient Access: Identify compliant opportunities for new customer engagement, digital services, access pathways and commercial innovation within the ecosystem. · Team Leadership & Execution Oversight: Provide direction, oversee key commercial campaigns and ensure delivery against business priorities. · Market Intelligence & Compliance: Monitor customer, platform and competitive trends while ensuring all channel activities comply with applicable policies, laws and internal governance. EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE · Bachelor's degree or above; marketing, business, healthcare or a related discipline preferred. · Typically 5+ years of relevant commercial experience, including substantial pharmaceutical/healthcare e-commerce, platform partnership or channel leadership exposure. · Demonstrated platform experience and strong understanding of pharmaceutical e-commerce business models, operations and regulatory requirements. · Proven ability to lead business planning, external partnerships, cross-functional alignment and commercial performance management. SKILLS REQUIREMENTS · Strong strategic thinking, business judgment, stakeholder influence and cross-functional collaboration. · Excellent communication and presentation skills in Chinese and English. · Strong execution, planning, problem-solving and adaptability in a dynamic commercial environment. INTEGRITY & COMPLIANCE Perform all responsibilities in accordance with Pfizer policies, applicable laws, industry codes and internal approval processes. Maintain integrity, transparency and appropriate handling of patient and business information. FOR INTERNAL APPLICANTS Internal applicants must meet applicable company eligibility, compliance and performance requirements. job_description_raw: 职责概述 医学信息沟通大区经理负责管理所辖区域的一切业务，包括制订和实施区域的工作目标和发展计划，建立一个绩效良好、极富生产力和士气高昂的团队。对客户的需求做出适当反应以实现区域的各项工作目标。对团队成员的行为进行规范和监管，对他们的专业技能提升和学习发展规划提供辅导和支持。 主要工作和任务 1. 制订并执行所辖区域的业务计划，推动大区各个团队实现公司和上级下达的各项工作目标和任务。 2. 招聘符合公司基本要求的人员，定期对团队成员进行绩效和行为的评估，实施奖惩或激励措施。 3. 制订并执行培养团队成员合规意识的计划，规范员工的工作行为，确保各项活动的真实性和合规性。 4. 制订并执行团队成员专业知识和技能的发展计划，通过随访对团队成员定期进行教导，以加强其专业能力、产品知识、产品策略、医学信息沟通技巧和总体工作效率，并对其个人发展规划提供指导与支持。 5. 根据大区业务发展的方向进行人力资源分配和人才规划，促进区域健康良性发展，建立人才梯队，保留高绩效人才。 6. 通过跟进计划，各团队的工作汇报和和随访等，深入了解各个团队的工作进展并进行针对性的辅导，包括业务及市场活动，人员管理和辅导，人才发展和保留等工作。 7. 根据对市场发展趋势的分析，挖掘区域市场机会，打造大区的长期竞争优势。 8. 协调并组织大区内的重要项目及活动，合理分配和控制各项资源。 9. 与区域内关键客户保持持续的沟通，前瞻性预测客户学术需求的变化，建立并持续优化战略合作伙伴关系。 10. 熟悉对当前及未来业务有影响的政策，必要情况下可根据公司的要求，与相关职能部门合作，参与或协调所辖区域的市场准入工作。 11. 建立和保持有效沟通系统，包括定期召开大区会议，定期与上级汇报区域工作进展，与其他部门建立跨部门沟通和合作关系。 12. 为制订和修改业务相关的政策和流程及其他内部政策提供建议，以实现高效率的业务运作。 13. 支持公司的各项创新举措，带领大区各个团队执行新举措，搭建创新平台。 14. 完成上级经理指派的其他各项工作。 任职要求 教育： - 大学本科及以上学历，医学，药学，生命科学等相关专业优先。 技能： - 熟练使用MS Office，英语良好。 - 具备较好的相关产品领域的专业知识。 - 具备较强的领导力和战略思维能力。 - 具备较强的沟通，计划，组织和问题解决能力。 - 具备较强的团队合作意识。 - 具备较强的学习意愿和学习能力。 - 善于自我激励，自我挑战和管理压力。 经验： - 至少 3 年制药行业同等公司的业务管理工作经验，具备符合合规要求的，优秀的绩效记录。 诚信： - 大学本科及以上学历，医学，药学，生命科学等相关专业优先。 技能： - 熟练使用MS Office，英语良好。 - 具备较好的相关产品领域的专业知识。 - 具备较强的领导力和战略思维能力。 - 具备较强的沟通，计划，组织和问题解决能力。 - 具备较强的团队合作意识。 - 具备较强的学习意愿和学习能力。 - 善于自我激励，自我挑战和管理压力。 经验： - 至少 3 年制药行业同等公司的业务管理工作经验，具备符合合规要求的，优秀的绩效记录。 诚信： - 能够严格管理自己的行为，确保日常工作全部遵循公司政策、行业准则以及相关法律，包括但不限于 FCPA (《反海外腐败法》)及相关中国大陆境内相关反腐法律条款。严守诚信，保持真实透明，在过往的工作中无任何违反法律规定的行为发生。 内部申请资格： - 内部申请人需符合现行合规调查流程，处分等级&时限等的要求。 - 至少有 2 年辉瑞业务管理工作经验。 - 过去两年的团队绩效，需达到或超过团队平均水平。 核心能力 专业合规: 构建专业体系-在大区内建立专业能力标准体系，通过流程和机制提升团队整体的专业能力。 营造合规氛围-准确理解合规各项规定的意义和原则，培养团队合规意识，规范团队合规行为，防范合规风险。 业务决断: 策略规划业务-策略性地规划大区的业务发展，在抓住市场机会的同时持续打造大区的长期竞争优势。宏观掌控市场-通过数据分析，通盘掌握大区整体市场的变化，并对市场趋势进行预判。 客户融动: 优化合作策略-预测大区客户需求的变化，建立战略合作伙伴关系，通过策略性合作提升辉瑞竞争优势。建立协作机制-建立并优化合作机制，为协作建立共同的目标，并积极推动持续的跨部门沟通和合作。 组织发展: 营造正向氛围-激发团队信息，营造积极的团队氛围。 搭建人才梯队-通过系统的培养体系提升大区人员的能力，搭建人才梯队。 自主执行: 建立执行机制-在大区内建立和推广高效执行的标准和全面管理机制，在系统及机制层面提升执行效果。勇于全面担责-对于大区的绩效承担最终责任，主动设定挑战性目标促进工作不断优化。 自我发展: 全面完善自我-审视职业理想和目标，寻求和创造学习机会以促进全面素养的提升。 创新变革: 搭建创新平台-主动探索创新和变革的机会，营造创新变革环境，并推动团队变革。 Pfizer is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable equal employment opportunity legislation in each jurisdiction in which it operates. As a Field Service Engineer [Customer Engineer] at Applied Materials, you serve as the direct liaison with customers, collaborating closely to install, maintain, and upgrade equipment. You'll use digital analytics for troubleshooting and apply basic diagnostic techniques to assess and address technical issues. Your responsibilities include performing preventative and corrective maintenance on various systems such as electrical, vacuum, mechanical, plasma, hydraulic, and gas systems. Additionally, you'll coordinate and communicate directly with customers to ensure smooth operations and exceptional service.  
 Role Responsibilities:   
 Install, maintain, and upgrade customer equipment
 Apply basic diagnostic techniques to assess equipment and address technical issues, with assistance from Senior Field Service Engineers [Customer Engineers]
 Collaborate with Senior Field Service Engineers [Customer Engineers] and/or the customer to understand roadmaps, process flows, inflection points, requirements, and business challenges   
 Train and mentor junior Field Service Engineers [Customer Engineers]
 Perform preventative and corrective maintenance on electrical, vacuum, mechanical, plasma, hydraulic, and gas systems
 Coordinate and communicate directly with customers
 Fulfill additional duties, as assigned
 Minimum Qualifications:   
 Completion of an Associate degree, military technical training, field service experience, or trade certification
 4-7 years of work experience in semiconductor industry or other equipment support industry
 Advanced mechanical aptitude with pneumatics, hydraulics, electronics, vacuum, and/or thermodynamics
 Strong knowledge of hand tools and their appropriate usage, including digital multimeters
 Effective written and verbal communication skills
 Basic knowledge of Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint   
 Possession of a valid driver’s license and the ability to obtain a passport, if travel is required.
 Able to meet all on-site requirements, including safety, environmental guidelines, and COVID-19 protocols
 Physical Requirements:   
This position often requires extensive walking, standing for extended periods of time, working in tight spaces, bending, squatting, twisting, kneeling, reaching, climbing stairs and ladders, working at height, lifting up to 35 lbs., the ability to distinguish between colors and working with electricity, the ability to work in an environment with noise that may be difficult for some individuals with sensitivity to noise, and the use of hand and power tools.   Additionally, because this position generally involves working in a clean room, it requires the use of appropriate Personal Protective Equipment such as coveralls, hoods, booties, safety glasses, gloves, respirators, chemical aprons, and face shields.   
 Additional Information

Full time

Assignee / Regular 
 Travel: 
Yes, 20% of the Time 
 Relocation Eligible: 
Yes

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, citizenship, ancestry, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, veteran or military status, or any other basis prohibited by law.

 Position Summary 
 The EHS Engineer provides day-to-day environmental, health and safety support for site, lab and applicable field/service activities. The role primarily focuses on environmental engineering, regulatory compliance and sustainability , while supporting workplace safety, risk management and continuous improvement.
 Key Responsibilities 
 Environmental Engineering & Sustainability – 70% 
 Support compliance with applicable China environmental regulations, permits and corporate EHS requirements , and maintain required compliance records and documentation.
 Manage routine hazardous and non-hazardous waste activities , including waste classification, labeling, storage, vendor coordination, disposal documentation and recordkeeping.
 Support wastewater, air emissions and environmental monitoring , including sampling/testing coordination, data review and corrective action follow-up.
 Conduct environmental inspections and compliance assessments; identify gaps and track corrective actions to closure.
 Support chemical and environmental risk assessments , spill prevention/response, and environmental reviews for new chemicals, equipment and process changes.
 Support site sustainability initiatives , including waste minimization, recycling, water conservation, energy efficiency and resource optimization.
 Collect, validate, analyze and report environmental and sustainability data , including energy, water, waste and other applicable environmental metrics, ensuring data accuracy and timely reporting.
 Support environmental and sustainability improvement projects through performance trend analysis, opportunity identification, implementation and action tracking .
 Safety Management – 30% 
 Conduct workplace EHS inspections and support hazard identification, JHA/JSA and operational risk assessments for site, lab and applicable field/service activities.
 Support contractor safety management , including EHS requirements, worksite inspections and corrective action follow-up.
 Participate in EHS reviews for new equipment, processes and Management of Change (MOC) activities.
 Support incident and near-miss investigations , root cause analysis, corrective/preventive actions and lessons learned.
 Deliver assigned EHS training, orientation and safety communications , and promote employee EHS awareness and participation.
 Support implementation and continuous improvement of site EHS programs and initiatives.
 Qualifications 
 Bachelor’s degree or above in Environmental Engineering, Environmental Science, Safety Engineering, Chemical Engineering or a related discipline ; Environmental Engineering/Science preferred.
 2–4 years of relevant environmental/EHS experience preferred , ideally in semiconductor, electronics, high-tech manufacturing, engineering/service or a multinational environment.
 Practical knowledge of environmental compliance, waste management, wastewater/air emissions, environmental monitoring, chemical management and workplace safety .
 Experience with environmental/sustainability data collection, analysis and reporting is preferred.
 Familiarity with ISO 14001 / ISO 45001, risk assessment and incident investigation is preferred.
 Strong analytical, documentation, problem-solving and action-tracking skills, with good communication skills in Chinese and English .
 Ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams, contractors and external service providers.
 China Registered Safety Engineer or other relevant environmental/EHS qualification is a plus.

job_description_raw: 职责概述 医学信息沟通专员在医学信息沟通地区经理的领导和辅导下，负责所辖区域内的产品学术推广和客户专业支持，如拜访客户传递/沟通/反馈药品信息、召开产品学术推广活动等，从而实现工作目标（包括但不限于专业技能、行为、合规及业绩等综合考评目标）。 主要工作和任务 1. 在公司政策和程序指引下向客户提供及时准确的专业支持，建立合作伙伴关系。 2. 在公司政策和程序指引下充分利用资源进行有效的客户拜访，实现工作目标。 3. 在公司政策和程序指引下规划和组织各种学术会议或活动。 4. 通过公司管理系统以及其他合规的渠道和方式，收集市场和客户反馈的信息，进行分析，反馈和建议。 5. 与上级经理，同事和其他部门的业务伙伴保持有效的联络，发现和促进各种合作机会。 6. 在上级经理的辅导下，把握各种学习机会不断提升专业知识和能力。 7. 执行公司推行的各项新举措，在公司政策和程序引导下探索创新和优化的机会。 8. 完成上级经理指派的其他各项工作。 任职要求 • 教育： - 具有《医药代表管理办法》（包括不时的修订）要求的医学、药学或相关专业大学专科及以上学历。 • 技能： - 熟练使用MS Office，英语良好。 - 具有较强的沟通能力和团队合作意识。 - 具备较强的学习意愿和学习能力。 - 善于自我激励，自我挑战和管理压力。 • 经验： - 医药行业相关工作经验优先。 • 诚信： - 能够严格管理自己的行为，确保日常工作全部遵循公司政策、行业准则以及相关法律，包括但不限于 FCPA 及相关中国大陆境内相关法律条款。严守诚信，保持真实透明，在过往的工作中无任何违反法律规定的行为发生。 核心能力 专业合规: 坚持专业推广-掌握并正确运用产品，治疗，疾病领域的知识，面对客户展现专业形象。严格坚守合规-工作中严格遵从合规要求，及时澄清问题并报告有合规风险的行为。 业务决断: 把握市场动态-随时把握市场动态，并且能敏锐地发现学术推广机会。 有效利用信息-合法合规地收集和运用信息，有理有据地分析并从中挖掘学术推广机会。 客户融动: 提供专业支持-积极与外部客户，包括医生，专家和其他合作伙伴进行互动，快速响应客户的学术需求，准确及时地提供专业支持。 主动促进合作-对内部客户主动沟通，寻求机会促进相互理解，建立合作关系。 自主执行: 高效准确执行-及时准确不打折扣地执行各项工作。 主动承担任务-对待工作认真负责，有始有终，遇到问题主动承担，遇到困难坚持达成目标。 Pfizer is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable equal employment opportunity legislation in each jurisdiction in which it operates. job_description_raw:
Who We Are 
 Applied Materials is the global leader in materials science and engineering solutions that are at the foundation of virtually every new semiconductor chip and advanced display in the world. The equipment that we create and service is essential to advancing AI and accelerating the commercialization of next-generation semiconductor chips. Join us and push the boundaries of materials science and engineering in a company at the foundation of the electronics industry. The work we do together advances the world’s technology. 
 What We Offer 
 Location:
Shanghai,CHN 
 You’ll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible—while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more. 
 At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We’re committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits . 
 Role Summary 
 This is a critical position within the AGS FSO SPO Organization, embedded in the Global Program Adoption (GPA) team. The Regional Program Adoption (RPA) enables effective adoption, sustained utilization, and productivity improvement across Field Service Operations through structured change management, field communications, and business process training.
 The RPA focuses on representing field challenges, facilitating field communication, and supporting change management through the Prosci process. Key responsibilities include driving cross-functional collaboration, supporting regional program adoption and training, communicating updates, championing process efficiencies, and resolving complex field operational issues.
 The role requires deep knowledge of Field Service Operations, AGS Operations, Sales, data analytics, and change management, with preferred qualifications including project management and change management certification, and over five years of field service experience.
 Key Focus Areas 
 1) Voice of the Field Service Operations 
 Represent regional field perspectives for SPO–sponsored programs and initiatives
 by articulating local operational realities, constraints, priorities, and cultural considerations
 Act as a bi-directional conduit between global project teams and regional field service organizations: Bring regional insights into program/project design, sequencing, rollout strategy, and readiness planning
 Translate global intent and standards into regionally relevant guidance and execution considerations
 Translate field feedback into actionable recommendations influencing project scope and deployment approach
 Advocate for solutions that improve field productivity, efficiency, and user experience within the represented region
 2) Field Communications 
 Plan and execute field-facing communications to drive awareness, understanding, and readiness for change
 Facilitate communication between global project teams and regional field organizations through multiple channels, including: Field Council and Field Engineer Info Session
 Regional All Hands and FSO Staff Meeting
 Global Field Manager and Field Engineer Conference
 Applied4You, Field Notifications and other digital platforms
 Support localization and translation of communication materials into local languages where required, ensuring clarity and cultural relevance while maintaining alignment with global intent
 Ensure consistent messaging around new or changing business processes, operating expectations, and adoption timelines
 3) Change Management, Program Adoption & Business Process Training 
 Guide and coach regional Field POCs on structured change management activities aligned with Prosci or equivalent methodologies
 Partner with Program Managers and Change Practitioners to: Assess regional stakeholder impacts and readiness
 Identify adoption risks and mitigation actions
 Support sponsor/stakeholder engagement and reinforcement planning
 Design, coordinate, and deliver business process–focused training (workflows, behaviors, ways of working)
 Support localization and translation of training materials into local languages where necessary to improve comprehension and effectiveness
 Establish feedback loops and adoption signals to identify gaps and recommend corrective actions (e.g., reinforcement, additional comms, refresher training)
 Key Responsibilities 
 Serve as the regional program adoption enablement focal point for programs and projects impacting Field Service Operations
 Guide and coach regional Field POCs on adoption approach, sequencing, readiness, and risk mitigation
 Drive cross-functional collaboration between global project teams and impacted organizations (e.g., FSO, GIS, AGS Operations, and other functional teams)
 Support program change management activities, including tracking milestones, dependencies, issues/risks, and adoption blockers
 Communicate key program updates through Field Councils, Info Sessions, Field Conferences, Applied4You, Field Notification, and other appropriate channels
 Identify opportunities to simplify, standardize, and streamline field processes to improve productivity and reduce friction
 Anticipate complex issues and facilitate resolution through alignment, structured problem solving, and stakeholder engagement
 Support translation and localization of communication and training materials to suit regional language and cultural context, as needed
 Collect structured feedback from the field and provide actionable insights to global project teams to improve rollout effectiveness and adoption outcomes
 Functional Knowledge & Skills 
 Strong understanding of Field Service Operations and field-facing workflows
 Strong program management fundamentals with the ability to manage complex work across a matrix organization
 Working knowledge and practical application of Prosci or structured change management processes
 Ability to design and deliver effective business process training and reinforcement plans for Field audiences
 Strong data and analytical skills to monitor adoption, utilization, and productivity indicators and translate insights into actions
 Broad understanding of FSO systems, tools, and operating practices
 Business Expertise 
 Applies change management principles to accelerate adoption and sustained utilization of new processes and ways of working
 Leverages operational knowledge to influence program requirements that improve organizational efficiency and productivity
 Balances global standards with regional execution realities without fragmenting process consistency
 Problem Solving 
 Applies a structured, cross-functional approach to resolve complex and ambiguous business challenges
 Navigates competing priorities and constraints while maintaining focus on adoption outcomes and field productivity impact
 Interpersonal & Communication Skills 
 Excellent written and verbal communication skills
 Comfortable presenting to medium to large audiences across field and management levels
 Effective communication across diverse cultures, regions, and knowledge levels
 Strong facilitation, influencing, and stakeholder management skills without direct authority
 Builds trust-based relationships to drive alignment, readiness, and adoption
 Able to surface issues early and use constructive challenge to drive resolution
 Qualifications 
 Education 
 Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience
 Experience 
 Minimum 7–10 years of relevant professional experience
 Preferred: 5+ years of Field Service or Field Operations experience
 Demonstrated experience in: Program adoption/ deployment/ rollout enablement
 Change management execution in a matrix environment
 Cross-functional collaboration across multiple stakeholder groups
 Certifications (Preferred) 
 Prosci Certified Change Practitioner (or comparable change management certification)
 PMP or equivalent program/project management certification
 Additional Preferences 
 Experience supporting global/regional field organizations and geographically distributed teams
 Exposure to cross-functional environments (e.g., SPG, OCE, DEG or similar)
 Additional Information 
 Time Type: 
Full time 
 Employee Type: 
Assignee / Regular 
 Travel: 
Yes, 25% of the Time 
 Relocation Eligible: 
No
